node.statement: At n=1, node 1.3 gives ||gamma(x)||>=(1-ke)||x||; after decreasing e_0 so that ke<=1/2, gamma^{-1} exists and ||gamma^{-1}||<=2. With D=tilde_gamma-gamma, ||gamma^{-1}D||<=2qe. Decrease e_0 also so that 2qe<1 (for example 2qe<=1/2). Then I+gamma^{-1}D is invertible by the norm-convergent Neumann series, and tilde_gamma=gamma(I+gamma^{-1}D) is bijective. The preceding child and def-extended-delta-inclusion therefore make tilde_gamma an extended C_tilde e-isomorphism. This repairs exact involution without a new hypothesis; only the already identified absence of an epsilon bound prevents deduction of the root contract.
